reason: The Freddie Mac Conventional Small product is disclosed as covering loans from $2 million to $10 million (per the April 15, 2026 launch announcement). A $1.5 million request falls below the disclosed minimum of $2 million, so the requested amount is outside the product's stated range. The source does not indicate that exceptions below the $2M floor are available, distinguishing this from guidelines that explicitly allow case-by-case consideration. Additionally, the former Small Balance Loan program (which historically accommodated smaller loans) stopped accepting applications on April 30, 2026, so that pathway is no longer available as of the September 7, 2026 request date.
missing_information: Whether Freddie Mac permits any below-minimum exceptions to the $2M floor on Conventional Small

Property, sponsor, and financial details of the subject request needed for any eligibility assessment beyond loan amount
Whether an alternative Freddie Mac or agency product (or a different lender channel) is appropriate for a $1.5M request
